title: Texas Seller's Disclosure Notice
description: Texas Property Code §5.008 requires sellers of residential property to complete the TREC-approved Seller's Disclosure Notice before or at contract execution.

required_actions.note: Exemptions: transfers between family members, foreclosure sales, new construction by builder.

title: Information About Brokerage Services
description: Texas brokers must provide the TREC-prescribed IABS form at first substantive discussion.

title: Flood Disclosure (SB 339)
description: Texas SB 339 (2019) requires sellers to disclose if property has flooded previously and if it is in a 100-year or 500-year flood plain or floodway.

required_actions.note: Included on TREC OP-H. Must indicate FEMA flood zone designation and prior flood events.

title: Municipal Utility District (MUD) Notice
description: If property is within a MUD, seller must provide the TREC-prescribed MUD disclosure notice at or before contract signing.
